sample_unit: deidentified EHR encounters (each run four times with race/ethnicity varied)

links.outcome: Differences in ChatGPT output sentiment, subjectivity, and word frequency when only patient race/ethnicity or insurance was varied
links.effect: Mean polarity 0.14, 0.14, 0.15, 0.14 by race; subjectivity 0.46 for all; polarity and subjectivity differences not significant, but word frequency differed significantly by race and subjectivity by insurance type.
links.quote: The differences in polarity and subjectivity across races/ethnicities were not statistically significant.

screen.reason: Empirical study testing for racial, ethnic, and insurance-related bias in ChatGPT-generated patient text using deidentified EHR encounters, without evaluating an organizational deployment guardrail or practice.
